app_info.subtitle: Review and learn vocabulary
app_info.description: yap helps language learners review due flashcards, practice words in example sentences and translation challenges, add vocabulary, search the course dictionary, and check learning progress through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the user's course dictionary and returns matching entries without changing account data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends an event that adds selected vocabulary cards to the user's private yap deck.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the authenticated user's private yap account and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds cards through an append-only event and does not delete or overwrite existing account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves currently due cards and lockup counts without changing their scheduling state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated user's private yap deck.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends an event that releases the next eligible batch of cards from lockup into the user's due queue.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the authenticated user's private yap deck and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Releases cards through an append-only event without deleting or overwriting review history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds and displays an interactive flashcard challenge without itself recording a review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays private course content inside ChatGPT and does not publish it externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds and displays a corpus-based translation challenge without itself recording a review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays private course content inside ChatGPT and does not publish it externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Autogrades the user's answer and appends a translation-review event that updates private learning progress.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the answer through yap's grading service and changes only the authenticated user's private yap account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Records an append-only review event and does not delete or overwrite existing review history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing human recording or synthesizes pronunciation audio without changing learning progress.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns audio privately to the widget and does not publish or message any external audience.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends the user's chosen review rating and updates spaced-repetition scheduling in their private yap account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the authenticated user's private learning data and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Records an append-only review event and does not delete or overwrite existing review history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves attributed example sentences for a validated dictionary gram without changing account data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns course content privately and does not publish or alter an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates and returns the user's learning statistics without changing account data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated user's private yap learning data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches public dictionary entries for the user's course without modifying any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns existing public dictionary links but does not create or modify public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one dictionary entry and its example sentences without modifying any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns an existing public dictionary link but does not create or modify public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change data.

test_cases.description: Find vocabulary and add a confirmed selection to the user's deck.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the French word for 'neighborhood', show me the matching dictionary entries, and add the one I confirm to my yap deck.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows validated matching entries before confirmation, then reports which selected card was added or was already present.

test_cases.description: Run an interactive flashcard review from the due queue.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me one due yap card and let me review it interactively.
test_cases.expected_output: Displays a due flashcard with pronunciation audio and records only the grade selected by the user in the widget.

test_cases.description: Run a corpus-based translation review for an eligible due card.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a translation challenge for a written yap card I have reviewed before.
test_cases.expected_output: Displays a comprehensible corpus sentence, grades the user's typed translation, explains the result, and records one review event.

test_cases.description: Retrieve comprehensible examples for a dictionary word.
test_cases.user_prompt: Look up 'pourtant' in my yap course and give me three example sentences composed of words I already know.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the validated entry and up to three comprehensible attributed sentences while separating harder examples.

test_cases.description: Summarize progress and provide a citable public dictionary entry.
test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize my yap progress, then find and cite the dictionary page for 'bonjour'. If cards are in lockup, ask before releasing the next batch.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes private learning statistics, returns a readable dictionary entry with its public URL, and unlocks cards only after confirmation when applicable.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general-purpose translation outside yap practice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Translate this business email into French for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because general document translation is outside its supported learning workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for today's news from Paris.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it searches yap dictionary content rather than the general web or news sources.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for flashcards managed in another product.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Anki deck from these lecture notes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only manages the authenticated user's yap deck and cannot create Anki decks.
